episodes.synopsis: Kuromi has a sister?! Yes, she does! In this episode, Kuromi shares with Baku all about her long lost sister, Romina. With only memories and a photo, she makes plans to go find her sister. Will they be able to find her with just a photo?
episodes.title: Kuromi Has a Sister?

episodes.synopsis: Kuromi is excited to see her big sister! As she’s en route to Paris, she goes down memory lane. Will she be reunited with her super nice and super smart sister?
episodes.title: A Memory From The Past

episodes.synopsis: Kuromi made it to her first destination, Paris. As she’s looking for her sister, she bumps into 3 guys who mistakenly take her for someone else. Are they looking for her sister as well? Will she be bumping into any new friends on her journey to find her sister?
episodes.title: Kuromi in Paris

episodes.synopsis: While in Paris, Kuromi reminisces about her sister with Gureco and Baku. But Gureco wants more than just to help Miss Kuromi. Find out what magical mishaps happen when Gureco’s around.
episodes.title: Kuromi Overload

episodes.synopsis: Baku and Gureco find Kuromi and a NEW friend in the kitchen. What new adventures and food await for the four of them?
episodes.title: Goodbye, Kuromi

episodes.synopsis: Kuromi and crew are now in New York looking for Romina (and cheesecake). So what better way to enjoy her time than in a musical number fit for broadway.
episodes.title: Life is a Cheesecake

episodes.synopsis: While in New York Kuromi bumps into an executive producer who promises fame will help her find her sister. But will fame be enough for Miss Kuromi’s cheeky personality?
episodes.title: A Star is Born

episodes.synopsis: While on her phone, Kuromi and crew plot what their next foodie adventure while naming their new friend. Can you guess what name Kuromi picked?
episodes.title: Online Persona

episodes.synopsis: While thinking about her sister, Kuromi remembers a moment when she went to go look for Dim Sum for her sister. Always making sure her sister had the best, so can you guess what the next location would be for Kuromi and crew?
episodes.title: Kuromi’s Tiny Adventure

episodes.synopsis: While in Hong Kong, Kuromi bumps into the trio  Koro, Moru, Hachi. After dealing with them she finds a new clue. And a new adventure awaits!
episodes.title: Enter the Pink Skull

episodes.synopsis: Gureco wants to impress Miss Kuromi with her style. Will she be able to stand out for Miss Kuromi? Watch and find out!
episodes.title: Just Like Kuromi

episodes.synopsis: While in Seoul, Kuromi gets asked to be on a dating show. Will she find her match?
episodes.title: The Odd Couple

episodes.synopsis: Ever wonder what a day with Baku looks like? Baku takes on a day of housekeeping with his new friend Koni.
episodes.title: Baku The Housekeeper

episodes.synopsis: While in Cancún, Kuromi makes Collimo enter into a Lucha Libre tournament in hopes of winning a wish granted. Will he be strong enough to win?
episodes.title: A New Talent

episodes.synopsis: Romina sees Kuromi excited watching her favorite TV character. She wonders what she would need to do to make Kuromi more focused on her. Will she figure out what she’s missing?
episodes.title: What Romina Wants

episodes.synopsis: While in Antarctica, Kuromi and Collimo are starving looking for Romina. They find a pile of fish to eat, but soon find out that was not a good idea. Find out what happens when they go to penguin court.
episodes.title: Penguin Court

episodes.synopsis: The evil crew is out of expenses so they need to think of an alternative plan to lure in Romina. But who or what will get Romina’s attention the quickest?
episodes.title: Romina vs The Evil Crew

episodes.synopsis: Gureco shares some very important information to Kuromi. Could this be the worst news for Kuromi?
episodes.title: The Worst Day Ever

episodes.synopsis: Baku finds out that Koni’s drawings are more than just drawings. Could Koni help Kuromi find her sister Romina?
episodes.title: Transformation Sequence

episodes.synopsis: Romina and Kuromi are together at last, but will Kuromi be able to protect her from the evil crew and their boss? And what more truth will be told?
episodes.title: The Truth Comes Out

episodes.synopsis: In the final episode, find out if Kuromi can save Romina. Is this goodbye forever?
episodes.title: Goodbye, Romina
